<includeonly>{{#cargo_query:
tables=UsedIn
|fields=UseType,TargetKey,Quantity,Slot
|where=ItemKey="{{{stablekey|}}}"
|order by=UseType ASC,TargetKey ASC
|format=template
|template=Item/UsedInQueryRow
|named args=yes
|delimiter=<br />
|default=
}}</includeonly><noinclude>Renders item-owned usage rows from Cargo.</noinclude>
